claims.statement: The aggregated battery record identifies Samsung INR18650-20R as a flat-top, unprotected 18650 cell.
Steam Engine preserves Samsung INR18650-20R 2000mAh 10C as a 2000mAh preset with a 10C runtime rating.
Samsung INR18650-20R has been academically characterized with a graphite negative electrode and an NMC532 positive electrode.
The exact catalog entry Samsung INR18650-20R has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2013-03-21 or earlier.
